# Are you a US tax resident yet?

> Free calculator for the IRS substantial presence test: enter your days in the US and see the 183-day weighted count (this year + a third of last year + a sixth of the year before), how many more days you can spend before you become a US tax resident, and when you crossed the line.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
